# Japan Land Service

> > Japan Land Service provides private chartered car tours, airport transfer services, and guided sightseeing experiences across Japan with multilingual support.

Japan Land Service specializes in customized private tours throughout Japan, offering services in Japanese, Chinese, and English. The company operates chartered vehicle tours using Toyota Alphard and HiAce vehicles, with particular focus on popular destinations including Hokkaido (Furano-Biei), Shirakawa-go, Boso Peninsula, and major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Hiroshima. They also provide specialized airport transfer services at Haneda Airport.

## Key Topics

- Private chartered car tours
- Haneda Airport transfers
- Chinese-speaking guides
- Toyota Alphard & HiAce vehicles
- Furano-Biei lavender tours
- Hokkaido sightseeing
- Shirakawa-go day trips
- Package tours vs private tours
- Multilingual tour services
- Airport meeting counter
- COVID-19 safe transfers
- Seasonal Japan travel (autumn leaves, winter snow)
- Boso Peninsula tours
- Japan Tourism Agency registered
- Customized itineraries

## Private Tour Services

- [富良野・美瑛1日観光(10時間)](https://japan-land-service.com/ja/tour/furano-biei-jp): 10-hour Furano-Biei chartered car tour from Sapporo (Japanese)
- [白川乡1日游 (8小时)](https://japan-land-service.com/zh/tour/shirakawa-go-cn): 8-hour Shirakawa-go private tour from Takayama (Chinese)
- [房总半岛1日游 (9小时)](https://japan-land-service.com/zh/tour/boso-peninsula-cn): 9-hour Boso Peninsula day tour from Tokyo with Chinese guide

## Airport Transfer & Meeting Services

- [「羽田空港」帰国者様送迎ハイヤープラン](https://japan-land-service.com/ja/covid19-haneda): COVID-19 safe Haneda Airport returnee transfer service (Japanese)
